text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to express my interest in renting the Castellan Imperial for our company launch event. We would like to begin the rental period on 29 April 2027 at 12.30pm and return it on Fri 30 Apr 2027 at 5:00 pm. We will be collecting it from your garage. It would be greatly appreciated if we could have one of your chauffeurs driving the vehicle during our rental. I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Kind regards,
Victor Marrowby
